The '''YT-series''' was a fairly popular series of light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Sometime prior to [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] had been subcontracted to give the entire series an overhaul.

Ships in the YT series featured a saucer-shaped hull, and were popular among [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] for their easy customization.
